canvas_settings.image_style: clean modern high-fidelity web app UI mockup, flat design, sans-serif typography, light theme

layers.description: Solid light grey page backdrop filling the entire square canvas behind everything else.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Root background layer; the browser window floats centered on top of it.

layers.description: A desktop browser window with rounded corners and a soft drop shadow, white content area, occupying most of the canvas; its chrome strip along the window top shows three small grey circular window buttons at the left and a wide rounded grey address bar holding the small grey web address "localhost:3000".
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Centered above the background; the app content sits inside its white content area below the chrome strip.

layers.description: App header band across the top of the white content area: on the left the bold dark heading "Kanban board"; on the right a rounded text input with grey placeholder text "Add a card…" followed by a blue rounded button with white label "Add".
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Inside the browser window content area, above the three board columns.

layers.description: A single rounded light column panel with a thin border titled by the bold heading "To Do" at its top, holding a single plain white card row with dark title "Buy milk" and two small grey labels "Edit" and "Delete" at its right edge; below the card the panel interior is empty.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Leftmost of three equal board columns arranged side by side with equal gaps.

layers.description: A single rounded light column panel with a thin border titled by the bold heading "In Progress" at its top, holding a single plain white card row with dark title "Refactor board module" and two small grey labels "Edit" and "Delete" at its right edge; below the card the panel interior is empty.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Middle of the three equal board columns.

layers.description: A single rounded column panel with a soft green-tinted border titled by the bold heading "Done" at its top, visually emphasized as the focal point, holding a vertical stack of three card rows separated by thin dividers; each card row shows a small solid green circular check icon at the left, then muted grey title text, then two small grey action labels "Edit" and "Delete" at the right edge. Card row titles, top to bottom: "Migrate todo list", "Set up CI", "Write release notes". No checkbox appears anywhere on these rows — the green check and the column itself are the entire done indicator.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Rightmost of the three equal board columns; its green border marks completion.

layers.description: A thin curved grey arrow with a small solid arrowhead drawn on top of the board, sweeping from the right edge of the "In Progress" column panel into the "Done" column panel, indicating the drag path that completes a card; the arrow carries no text.
layers.hierarchy_and_relation: Drawn above the column panels as a light annotation; purely a shape, no labels.
